Tibia has daytime.

The game features a dynamic day-night cycle, adding a realistic element to the gameplay. During the daytime, the game world is bathed in sunlight, providing clear visibility and illuminating Tibia's landscapes.

While the night brings darkness and its own set of challenges, the daytime introduces unique opportunities for players. Engage in thrilling player-versus-player battles, embark on hunts, or undertake Quests to immerse yourself in captivating narratives and uncover hidden treasures within the vibrant and bustling environment.

In Tibia, the daytime period lasts between 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m., which corresponds to real-life times of hh:15 and hh:45. This means that during these hours, the world of Tibia is filled with the radiance of daylight.

The full day and night cycle in Tibia lasts for approximately one hour in real time, marking the passage of time and contributing to the dynamic nature of the game world.

To maintain fairness and ensure a level playing field, Tibia includes the Ambient Light slider in its advanced graphical settings. This feature allows players to adjust lighting conditions during the day, ensuring that no unfair advantages are gained.

By embracing both the night and the day mechanics, Tibia offers an immersive experience for players, adding depth, strategic elements, and a sense of realism to their gameplay.
